steps.ask: Which two ratios are equal, and what do the 4 : 6 parts tell you?
steps.title: Set up the ratio (Theorem 12)

lines.text: $DE \parallel BC$, so $\hl{3}{|AE|} : \hl{4}{|EC|} = \hl{1}{|AD|} : \hl{2}{|DB|} = 4 : 6$ (Theorem 12).

steps.ask: What do you get when you cross-multiply, and how do you collect the x terms?
steps.title: Cross-multiply and solve
Find $|XY|$ by Pythagoras in the right-angled triangle $AXY$

lines.text: $XY \parallel BC$ and $XZ \parallel AC$, so $XYCZ$ is a parallelogram and opposite sides are equal.

steps.title: Use the parallel lines to find $|BZ|$

lines.text: $XZ \parallel AC$ cuts $[BA]$ and $[BC]$ in the same ratio, so $|BZ| : |ZC| = |BX| : |XA|$.
Since $|AX| : |XB| = 1 : 2$ and $|AX| = 4$, we get $|XB| = 8$.
